description: We sat down with Academy Award–nominated VFX Supervisor Michael Ralla and Emmy Award–winning Visualization Supervisor Pepe Valencia of Baraboom! to explore how they brought these moments to life and to share even more insights in our latest fireside chat.

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Come join Eric and Dan from the Tech Audio team at Epic Games as they walk through powerful new resources for sound and music designers. During this presentation, viewers will learn more about the TechAudioTools ecosystem and the deep integration made possible by MetaSound Viewmodels. Topics will include MetaSounds, editor utilities, custom preset widgets, and viewmodels.
